# Cobalt Systems Q2 Call

## Inventory normalization

Excess semiconductor stocks declined after supplier lead times improved. Inventory returned to the company target range.

## Pricing

Cobalt reduced temporary freight surcharges. Core product prices remained unchanged.

## Cash flow

Lower component stocks released working capital. Free cash flow increased despite flat operating income.
